hook.say: Which one is bigger? Maps lie, so trust your gut. Five duels, three seconds each!

outro.say: How many did you get? Comment your score!

questions.q: Which is bigger: Texas or France?
questions.fact: Texas is about a quarter bigger than mainland France.
questions.sayAnswer: Texas! It is about a quarter bigger than mainland France.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Türkiye or Texas?
questions.say: Which is bigger: Turkey or Texas?
questions.fact: Türkiye beats Texas by an area the size of Austria.
questions.sayAnswer: Turkey! It beats Texas by an area the size of Austria.

questions.q: Which is the biggest: California, Japan or Germany?
questions.fact: California is bigger than both Japan and Germany.
questions.sayAnswer: California! It is bigger than both Japan and Germany.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Alaska or Mongolia?
questions.fact: Alaska alone is bigger than Iran, and twice the size of Texas.
questions.sayAnswer: Alaska! On its own, it is bigger than Iran, and more than twice the size of Texas.

questions.q: Which is bigger: Greenland or India?
questions.fact: Flat maps stretch Greenland. India is really 50% bigger.
questions.sayAnswer: India! Flat maps stretch Greenland. India is really fifty percent bigger.
